name: get_capture
description: Read authorized capture progress and per-action approval/partial outcomes. Case and approval links require authentication and contain no bearer authority. Recording saves explicitly return operation=recordingSave. Result-access status distinguishes saved evidence awaiting grant publication from collection failure. With after_revision the call waits server-side (at most 30 s) for the next change. view=settings returns the retained parameter snapshot for review or repeat instead; its strings are untrusted.

view.description: status (default) reads progress; settings reads the retained immutable parameter snapshot for review/editing: no old grants, secrets, reason or sharing. Settings above the 96 KiB MCP result bound return SettingsTooLarge with browser navigation; repeat by reference still works.

after_revision.description: Wait server-side until the state revision differs from this value or 30 seconds pass, then return the current state. Omit for an immediate read. Status reads are never charged.

reason_code.description: Bounded stable action reason. Failed Go profile acquisition reports ProfileUnavailable when the endpoint is unavailable or disabled, or ProfilerBusy for an existing conflicting profiling session that Asservat did not stop. Other existing reason strings retain their current meaning; a reason never authorizes retry or replacement.

action_instance_id.description: Exact child identity within this parent save. It is not a separate navigation or retry target.

sharing.description: Capture-time sharing status, reported separately from collection progress. Present only when the request included sharing. Shared names the concrete share; SharingUnavailable means the result was not shared (collection outcome is unaffected).

reason.description: Authorized parent Save reason, preserved verbatim; never restored on repeat.

reason_state.description: Omitted when no reason was supplied. Unavailable descriptive metadata does not block capture status.

namespace.description: Defaults to the object's own namespace; must equal it when given.

uid.description: Optional pin with adoption: pinUID; otherwise provenance only.

maxPods.description: Maximum pods collected per occurrence; never the monitoring coverage limit.

selection.description: Defaults to triggeringPod for policies and oldestReady for manual captures.

maxHeaderBytes.description: Common HTTP server header limits (nginx large_client_header_buffers 4 × 8 KiB) bound one request header block.

maxReassemblyBytes.description: Per-target reassembly memory budget; per-flow reassembly is 2 × maxHeaderBytes, so tracked flows = maxReassemblyBytes ÷ (2 × maxHeaderBytes); the default 16 MiB is derived from the node collector memory limit together with the ring budget.

filter.description: No length cap on the text; the bound is the compiled classic BPF program, which must fit the kernel limit BPF_MAXINSNS (4096 instructions), checked at compile, and the enclosing Kubernetes object size.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

ring.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

peers.description: Peer generations are bounded only by the compiled program limit (BPF_MAXINSNS 4096).

maxProcesses.description: The default batch covers every resolved main process of the Pod, sidecars included; the batch is bounded by maxProcesses × maxBytesPerProcess ≤ the action maxBytes and by maxTotalStop.

maxBytesPerProcess.description: Bounded only by the action and capture byte budget.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

d15.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

maxEventsPerSecond.description: Reviewed observation rate; the shipped default is derived from measured per-node collector event throughput. With the ring, it bounds every trace; there is no lifetime event total (ADR-335 D6).

maxTrackedThreads.description: Sizes the eBPF per-thread map (memory per tracked thread); derived from the collector map memory budget.

frequencyHz.description: Bounded by the node's kernel.perf_event_max_sample_rate, which the kernel lowers itself under load.

impact.description: observe for pprof GETs and the eBPF sampler; intrusive for forced GC, sampling changes, traces and attached profilers (ADR-335 D5).

source.description: Source object of an organization or namespace captureProfile dependency. A release-embedded builtin profile (ADR-243) has none; its profileComposition provenance names the builtin catalog.

version.description: Optional; omitted, the hub resolves the current version and records it.

d23.description: Peer generations are bounded only by the compiled program limit (BPF_MAXINSNS 4096).

d24.description: No length cap on the text; the bound is the compiled classic BPF program, which must fit the kernel limit BPF_MAXINSNS (4096 instructions), checked at compile, and the enclosing Kubernetes object size.

d33.description: Reviewed observation rate; the shipped default is derived from measured per-node collector event throughput. With the ring, it bounds every trace; there is no lifetime event total (ADR-335 D6).

d34.description: Pinned resolved profile. A builtin definition is embedded in the release binary (ADR-243) and is identified by its definition digest alone; organization and namespace definitions name their source cluster, namespace and object.
